_readme: Extra answers for the SadeekShop help widget, usually from questions it could not answer (see GoatCounter events under faq-miss/).
Add entries with: python src/tools/add_learned.py  (or edit by hand). Merged into assets/assistant-kb.json at build time.
keywords: words or short questions per language that should trigger the answer. answer: the reply per language (ar, en, fi).
links: optional buttons [{"t": {"ar":..,"en":..,"fi":..}, "h": "https://..."}]. Never put passwords or private data here: this file is public.
Keys starting with _ are ignored and never shown to visitors.

answer.ar: ShipOps: عندك أكثر من فرع؟ تواصل معنا على واتساب أو الإيميل ونرتب لك العرض المناسب. السعر للمكتب الواحد 15$ شهريًا أو 150$ سنويًا.
answer.en: ShipOps: have more than one branch? Contact us on WhatsApp or by email and we'll arrange the right offer. The price per office is $15/month or $150/year.
answer.fi: ShipOps: onko teillä useampi toimipiste? Ota yhteyttä WhatsAppissa tai sähköpostilla, niin sovitaan sopiva tarjous. Hinta toimistoa kohden on 15 $/kk tai 150 $/vuosi.
